verdict.rationale: Mailgun documents dedicated IP pools and IP pooling to manage sender reputation (mailgun-docs-23, mailgun-docs-11/29), and community evidence confirms Mailgun provisions dedicated IPs for deliverability issues (mailgun-comm-9). However, there is no evidence of a published warmup schedule or automated IP warmup/ramp-up process, which is the specific requirement of this story. Missing for 10: documented warmup schedule, automated ramp-up tooling, guidance on ramping volume on new dedicated IPs.
